changelog: rs-2026.09.0: 初版。正式仕様 docs/RUNNING_PRESCRIPTION_ENGINE_V2_SPEC.md の §3-§10 をデータ化。全 Evidence は SECONDARY_REPORT_ONLY、status=DRAFT（一次資料未照合のため ACTIVE 化しない）。

R3: added versioned constraints (U12 hard constraints, U15 ASSISTED_SPRINT non-overridable, maturity/training-age auto-complexity caps), SessionTemplate complexity (§7.5) and EligibilityRule.requiresPhaseEvaluation metadata. methods/envelopes/evidence/timingTolerances/stopPolicies/plausibility values unchanged. Status remains DRAFT.

R4: added structured machine-readable metadata so planning never parses human-readable text or identifier names: EligibilityRule.conditions / autoGenerationLimits (previously only described in conditionNote), SessionTemplate.approachType / resistanceBand / fixedDistanceField, StopPolicy.appliesToEligibilityPath, PlausibilityRule.inputTarget, and eventDefinitions (timed-mark and race-event distances). conditionNote is now explanatory only. methods/envelopes/evidence/timingTolerances/constraints and all stop-policy/plausibility/envelope numeric values unchanged. Status remains DRAFT.

R5: added versioned readinessRules (§13 pain red flag groups, pain PRESENT / NOT_ASKED gates, growth-period guidance regions, wellness thresholds and signal counts, readiness-window rule, SWAP target map). No numeric or scientific data changed: methods/templates/envelopes/evidence/eligibility/constraints/timingTolerances/stopPolicies/plausibility/eventDefinitions are byte-identical. Status remains DRAFT.

R6: added versioned aggregationRules (§11 accel interval A per tier, relay allowance, per-Method aggregation metadata, high-intensity budget, tempo/stride session limits, legacy category semantics) and plausibility outputTarget metadata. No numeric or scientific data changed: methods/templates/envelopes/evidence/eligibility/constraints/timingTolerances/stopPolicies/readinessRules/eventDefinitions and every plausibility threshold are unchanged. Status remains DRAFT.
